## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete task or failure and what this change enables.

## Scope and evidence

Identify affected skills/layers, source editions or revisions, and any licensing or compatibility implications. For significant skill changes, link the baseline/assisted artifacts and explain their limits.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results and skipped checks. Distinguish retained observations from fresh engine runs and stakeholder decisions.

- [ ] Relevant checks pass (`just check` for repository changes).
- [ ] Documentation and catalog reflect the change where applicable.
- [ ] Sources and adapted material have appropriate provenance and notices.
- [ ] Examples and captures contain only material safe to publish.

## Remaining limitations

State unsupported behavior, open questions or follow-up work. Do not claim untested client compatibility or language conformance.
